name: hfdl
description: HFDL (aircraft HF data link, ARINC 635) decoder: M-PSK demodulation at 1800 baud, slot framing, FEC, MPDU/LPDU/HFNPDU/SPDU and ACARS content, several channels inside one I/Q stream

options.name: --channel-offset
options.help: assigned HFDL channel frequency minus the I/Q centre, in Hz; the signal is the 3 kHz USB channel whose carrier is 1440 Hz above it

options.name: --centre
options.help: I/Q centre frequency; only used to report absolute frequencies

options.name: --hide-ids
options.help: blank aircraft identifiers (ICAO address, registration, flight id, aircraft data) in the output

options.name: --system-table
options.help: ground station table (dumphfdl systable.conf) for station names

options.name: --start-time
options.help: wall-clock time of the first sample; frame timestamps count from it (default 0)

options.name: --output-corrupted-pdus
options.help: also report PDUs that failed their CRC

options.name: --stats
options.help: print a stats line at the end

options.name: --chunk
options.help: read size (does not change the output)

events.help: one decoded LPDU / SPDU; hfdl is dumphfdl's own JSON object
